def find_Max_Num(digits):
    # Sort the digits in descending order to place larger numbers at higher significance positions
    sorted_digits = sorted(digits, reverse=True)
    
    # Convert each digit back to a string and join them together
    max_num_str = "".join(map(str, sorted_digits))
    
    return int(max_num_str)

# Test cases based on the requirement
assert find_Max_Num([1, 2, 3]) == 321
print("Test passed!")

# Additional test case with duplicates and larger numbers
digits_2 = [5, 4, 4, 9]
result_2 = find_Max_Num(digits_2)
expected_2 = 9544
assert result_2 == expected_2, f"Expected {expected_2}, got {result_2}"

print(f"All tests passed. Example output for [5, 4, 4, 9] is: {result_2}")
